options.label: Graphics API
options.help: Which graphics API draws the video. Try Automatic or Direct3D 11 if playback shows a black window or crashes.

options.label: Video sync
options.help: What paces the frames. A display mode times frames to the screen's refresh rate, which smooth motion needs.

options.label: Smooth motion
options.help: Blends neighbouring frames so motion doesn't judder when the frame rate doesn't divide the refresh rate. Needs a display video sync mode.

options.label: Upscaling filter
options.help: The filter that enlarges the picture after AI upscaling when the window is still bigger than the video.

options.label: Downscaling filter
options.help: The filter that shrinks the picture when the upscaled video is bigger than the window, for example 4K output on a 1440p screen.

options.label: Debanding
options.help: Smooths colour banding in gradients such as skies and dark scenes.

options.label: Deinterlacing
options.help: Removes the comb lines of interlaced video, common on DVDs and TV recordings. Automatic only acts on video marked as interlaced.

options.label: HDR passthrough
options.help: Tells the display the video's colour space so an HDR screen can show HDR video as HDR. Off maps HDR to SDR in the player.

options.label: HDR tone mapping
options.help: How HDR brightness is squeezed into what the screen can show, when the screen can't show the full range.

options.label: Precise seeking

choices.label: Jumps to a time, all seeks in audio files

options.help: Whether a seek lands on the exact frame or on the nearest keyframe, which is faster but less exact.

options.label: Start volume
options.help: The volume, in percent, the player starts at.

options.label: Maximum volume
options.help: How far, in percent, the volume can be raised. Above 100 boosts quiet audio and can distort it.

options.label: Speaker channels
options.help: The channel layout sent to your speakers. Stereo downmixes surround sound for headphones and TV speakers.

options.label: Exclusive audio
options.help: Takes the audio device for the player alone, bypassing the system mixer. Other apps go silent while it plays.

options.label: Passthrough codecs
options.help: Comma-separated codecs to send undecoded to an AV receiver over HDMI or S/PDIF. Leave empty to decode everything in the player.

options.label: Keep pitch when speeding up
options.help: Keeps voices at their normal pitch when playing faster or slower than normal.

options.label: Load external subtitles

choices.label: File name contains the video's name

options.help: Which subtitle files next to the video load with it. Applies from the next video.

options.label: Font
options.help: The font for plain-text subtitles such as SRT. Styled (ASS) subtitles keep their own fonts.

options.label: Font size
options.help: Text size of plain-text subtitles, in scaled pixels at a 720-line window height.

options.label: Scale
options.help: Makes all subtitles bigger or smaller: 1 is normal size, 1.2 is 20% bigger.

options.label: Vertical position
options.help: Where subtitles sit, in percent of the window height: 100 is the bottom, lower values move them up.

options.label: Style override
options.help: How much of your subtitle settings apply to styled (ASS) subtitles, which bring their own fonts and positions.

options.label: Blend into the video
options.help: Draws subtitles into the video frame. No draws them separately at screen resolution, which is sharper but can cost speed.

options.label: Start in fullscreen
options.help: Opens the player in fullscreen. Changing it here also switches the open player.

options.label: Always on top
options.help: Keeps the player window above other windows.

options.label: Window border and title bar
options.help: Shows the window frame. Off gives a borderless window.

options.label: Largest start size
options.help: Shrinks the window to fit this size when a video would open bigger, as a percent of the screen (90%x90%) or pixels (1600x900).

options.label: Snap to screen edges
options.help: Snaps the window to the screen edges and other windows when you drag it.

options.label: Hide the mouse pointer after
options.help: Milliseconds without mouse movement before the pointer hides over the video.

options.label: At the end

choices.label: Play the next file or close
Stay on the last frame of the playlist
Stay on the last frame of every file

options.help: What the player does when a video ends.

options.label: Resume where you left off
options.help: Remembers the playback position when you close the player and continues there next time.

options.label: Format
options.help: The image format screenshots are saved in.

options.label: Folder
options.help: Where screenshots are saved. ~~/ is the player's portable_config folder.

options.label: File name
options.help: The screenshot file name: %F is the video's name, %P the playback time, %n a running number.

options.label: JPEG quality
options.help: Quality of JPEG screenshots, 0 to 100. Higher is better and larger.

options.label: PNG compression
options.help: PNG compression level, 0 to 9. Higher makes smaller files but takes longer; the picture is the same.

options.label: Cache
options.help: Reads ahead into memory so playback doesn't stall on slow disks or networks.

options.label: Read ahead (seconds)
options.help: How many seconds ahead to buffer, within the memory limit below.

options.label: Memory for reading ahead
options.help: Most memory the cache uses for what comes next, such as 768MiB or 2GiB.

options.label: Memory for seeking back
options.help: Most memory kept of what already played, so seeking back is instant.

options.label: Pause while buffering
options.help: Pauses when the cache runs empty and continues once enough is buffered.

options.label: Audio languages
options.help: Preferred audio languages, comma-separated, first choice first. Applies from the next video.

options.label: Subtitle languages
options.help: Preferred subtitle languages, comma-separated, first choice first. Applies from the next video.

options.label: Subtitles when audio matches
options.help: Whether to show subtitles when the audio is already in a subtitle language you prefer.

options.label: Use the system language
options.help: Picks subtitles in your system's language when no subtitle language is set.

options.label: No subtitles in my languages
options.help: Which subtitles to show when none match your preferred languages.
